d.d: A person confined to an institution such as a prison (as a convict) or hospital (as a patient).
A person who shares a residence (such as a hotel guest, a lodger, or a student living on campus), or other place.
Synonym of passenger, a person held or riding within a vehicle.
superlative form of inner: most inner; the very deepest within; farthest from the surface or external part.
That which is inmost; the core.
